security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, fixed CLI examples, public links, and an image parameter name. The unpinned npx skill installations are genuine supply-chain risks, and reference-image editing sends user data to an external processor.

remediation.issue: Installation commands use unpinned npx and skill dependencies.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and every referenced skill to verified versions or immutable commits. Explain the dependency trust boundary before requesting installation.

remediation.issue: Reference-image processing can disclose user images to inference.sh.
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy notice covering transmission, storage, and retention. Warn users not to submit confidential images or private URLs without authorization.

content.user_title: Create and Edit Images with Qwen-Image-2
content.value_statement: Creating polished images and text-heavy graphics often requires several tools. This skill runs Qwen-Image-2 models through inference.sh for generation, editing, and controlled output.
actual_capabilities: Generates images from text prompts with Qwen-Image-2.0.
Uses Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro for detailed text rendering and posters.
Edits images using one to three reference-image URLs.
Requests one to six output images in a single run.
Controls width, height, negative prompts, prompt extension, watermarking, and seed.
Provides model search, sample input, and execution workflows for the belt CLI.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI, authentication, and network access.
Prompts and reference-image URLs are processed by an external service.
Image dimensions must remain within the documented pixel limits.
Generated text and visual details may still require review or regeneration.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Graphics
use_cases.description: Generate posters with specified headlines, colors, layouts, and dimensions using the Pro model.

use_cases.title: Produce Concept Variations
use_cases.description: Generate several visual directions from one prompt for rapid comparison and refinement.

use_cases.title: Edit Reference Images
use_cases.description: Combine subject, clothing, and pose references into a new image through multi-reference editing.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image of [subject] in [style] with [lighting]. Use Qwen-Image-2.0 and return one image.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a simple text-to-image result.

prompt_templates.title: Create Several Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [number] variations of [concept]. Use [width] by [height] pixels and avoid [unwanted details].
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants options with controlled dimensions.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Text-Heavy Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro to design a [format] poster. Include the exact text "[copy]" with [typography and placement].
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs precise visible copy in an image.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Multiple References
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit these authorized reference images: [URLs]. Preserve [elements], combine [attributes], use seed [seed], and describe the final composition before running.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs reproducible multi-reference editing.

output_examples.input: Create four minimalist coffee shop logo concepts with dark green lettering and simple cup shapes.
output_examples.output: Four PNG logo concepts with consistent minimalist styling, distinct cup symbols, and dark green typography.

output_examples.input: Design a vertical summer sale poster with exact headline and subtitle text.
output_examples.output: A 1024 by 1536 poster with the requested headline, subtitle, beach background, and clear text placement.

output_examples.input: Combine an authorized person, clothing, and pose reference into one edited image.
output_examples.output: One PNG image preserving the selected person while applying the requested clothing and pose references.

best_practices: Use the Pro model for posters, labels, and other text-heavy designs.
Place required visible text in quotes and specify its color, style, and position.
Use a fixed seed when comparing prompt changes or reproducing an approved result.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential images or private URLs without authorization.
Do not request dimensions outside the documented limits.
Do not rely on generated text without checking spelling, layout, and legibility.

faq.question: What is required before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the belt CLI, authenticate with inference.sh, and ensure network access is available.

faq.question: Which model should I use?
faq.answer: Use Qwen-Image-2.0 for general speed. Use the Pro model for posters, detailed realism, and important text.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide one to three authorized reference-image URLs and describe how their elements should be combined.

faq.question: Can I generate repeatable results?
faq.answer: Use the same prompt, model, settings, and seed. External model updates can still affect exact output.

faq.question: How many images can one request create?
faq.answer: The documented num_images setting supports one to six images.

faq.question: How should sensitive images be handled?
faq.answer: Do not submit confidential material unless you understand and accept the external service's privacy and retention terms.
